description: Source code for PEM private key handling functions in OpenSSL, including reading and writing private keys with support for various formats and encryption.

methods.name: PEM_read_bio_PrivateKey
methods.description: Reads a private key from a BIO, supporting multiple formats including PKCS8, RSA, EC, DSA.

methods.name: PEM_write_bio_PrivateKey
methods.description: Writes a private key to a BIO in PKCS8 format, with optional encryption.

methods.name: PEM_read_PrivateKey
methods.description: Reads a private key from a FILE pointer, internally uses BIO.

methods.name: PEM_write_PrivateKey
methods.description: Writes a private key to a FILE pointer, internally uses BIO.
